message.content:
A vertical rectangular magazine cover features a red background. At the top, a dark horizontal bar contains white text: "Iqra: Menyingkap Pemusnahan Buku Nasution". Below, the word "TEMPO" appears in large, black, serif capital letters. Smaller text reads "EDISI 22-28 Juli 2002".

The central illustration shows a large, stylized wooden structure shaped like a bull's head and torso, colored in shades of yellow and light brown with dark hatch marks indicating a wood-like texture. It has two large, curved horns and a visible eye. This bull structure is mounted on wheels. 

In the foreground, a man with dark hair, a tan face, and a black suit and tie stands looking to the left. He wears a bright yellow suit jacket and a white collared shirt with black tie. To the right, two smaller men in similar yellow suits and black ties are emerging from a door-like opening in the side of the wooden bull structure. One man stands in the doorway, while another descends a metal ladder. 

Large yellow text on the left reads "AWAS BAHAYA KUNING!". At the bottom left is a barcode and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN". On the bottom right, "Rp 14.733".
